title: Personal loan, RBI Key Facts Statement
scenario_prompt: Bank branch conversation in India. A loans officer explains a personal loan to a customer who speaks Hindi and English and switches between them mid-sentence. Topics: the loan amount, the monthly instalment, the tenure, the interest rate and whether it is fixed or floating, the annual percentage rate, the processing fee, the total amount repayable, foreclosure and prepayment charges, the cooling-off period, and the grievance officer. Expect rupee amounts, percentages, and the words KFS, APR, EMI, CIBIL, repo and foreclosure. Hindi words that appear: byaj, kist, shulk, kharcha, mahina, saal.

checkpoints.label: Loan amount, tenure and EMI

citation.instrument: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans and Advances, RBI/2024-25/19, 15 April 2024
citation.clause: Sanctioned loan amount, tenor and instalment in the Key Facts Statement

checkpoints.hint: State the sanctioned amount, the tenure and the monthly instalment.
checkpoints.spoken: the loan amount, the tenure and the monthly instalment

checkpoints.label: Interest rate, fixed or floating

citation.instrument: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans and Advances, RBI/2024-25/19, 15 April 2024
citation.clause: Interest rate and whether fixed or floating, with the benchmark for floating rates

checkpoints.hint: Say the interest rate and whether it is fixed or floating.
checkpoints.spoken: whether the interest rate is fixed or floating

checkpoints.label: Annual Percentage Rate, all inclusive

citation.instrument: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans and Advances, RBI/2024-25/19, 15 April 2024
citation.clause: Annual Percentage Rate disclosing the all-inclusive cost of the loan

checkpoints.hint: State the Annual Percentage Rate, the all-inclusive cost including every fee.
checkpoints.spoken: the annual percentage rate, the all inclusive cost

checkpoints.label: Processing and other fees

citation.instrument: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans and Advances, RBI/2024-25/19, 15 April 2024
citation.clause: Itemised fees and charges recovered from the borrower

checkpoints.hint: Name the processing fee and any other charges, with amounts.
checkpoints.spoken: the processing fee and the other charges

checkpoints.label: Total amount repayable

citation.instrument: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans and Advances, RBI/2024-25/19, 15 April 2024
citation.clause: Total amount to be repaid, being principal plus interest and charges

checkpoints.hint: Say the total amount the borrower repays over the whole tenure.
checkpoints.spoken: the total amount repayable over the whole tenure

checkpoints.label: Prepayment and foreclosure

citation.instrument: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans and Advances, RBI/2024-25/19, 15 April 2024
citation.clause: Prepayment and foreclosure charges, and cases where none apply

checkpoints.hint: Say what happens if the borrower repays early, and whether a charge applies.
checkpoints.spoken: what it costs to repay the loan early

checkpoints.label: Cooling-off period
patterns: (exit|cancel|opt out|return the loan|walk away) .{0,30}(without penalty|no penalty|\d+ days?)

citation.clause: Cooling-off or look-up period during which the borrower may exit without penalty

checkpoints.hint: State the cooling-off period in which the borrower can exit without a penalty.

checkpoints.label: Grievance officer and recovery practice

citation.instrument: Master Circular on Fair Practices Code for NBFCs / Banks
citation.clause: Grievance redressal contact and the recovery practices the lender follows

checkpoints.hint: Give the grievance officer contact and how recovery is handled.
checkpoints.spoken: who to complain to if something goes wrong

prohibited.label: No cost or zero interest EMI

citation.instrument: Master Circular on Fair Practices Code for NBFCs / Banks
citation.clause: Zero percent interest schemes misrepresent the true cost of credit and are not permitted

prohibited.correction: There is no zero cost loan. The interest is inside the price or the fee.

prohibited.label: Guaranteed approval

citation.instrument: Master Circular on Fair Practices Code for NBFCs / Banks
citation.clause: No assurance of sanction before credit appraisal is complete

prohibited.correction: No loan is approved before the credit check. Sanction depends on the appraisal.

prohibited.label: No hidden charges, with no APR given

citation.instrument: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans and Advances, RBI/2024-25/19, 15 April 2024
citation.clause: Every charge recovered from the borrower must appear in the Key Facts Statement

prohibited.correction: Say the annual percentage rate. That is the only number that includes every charge.
corrected_patterns: (these|the) charges are .{0,25}(listed|in the key facts|in the kfs)

prohibited.label: Insurance presented as compulsory

citation.instrument: Master Circular on Fair Practices Code for NBFCs / Banks
citation.clause: Bundled insurance must be optional and the borrower's choice of insurer preserved

prohibited.correction: Insurance with this loan is optional. You choose whether to take it.

prohibited.label: Claim that the credit score is unaffected

citation.instrument: Master Circular on Fair Practices Code for NBFCs / Banks
citation.clause: Credit information reporting to bureaus is mandatory and must not be misdescribed

prohibited.correction: This loan is reported to the credit bureaus. A missed instalment lowers your score.

prohibited.label: Pressure to sign now

citation.instrument: Master Circular on Fair Practices Code for NBFCs / Banks
citation.clause: No coercion or undue pressure in the sale of a credit product

prohibited.correction: There is no need to decide today. Take the key facts statement home first.

teachback_topics.label: The all-inclusive cost
expected_points: the annual percentage rate includes every fee, not just the interest
teachback_topics.hint_hi: APR mein saare charges shaamil hote hain, sirf byaj nahi.

teachback_topics.label: Instalment and tenure
expected_points: how much is paid each month
for how many months or years
teachback_topics.hint_hi: Har mahine kitna, aur kitne saal tak.

teachback_topics.label: Fixed or floating
expected_points: a floating rate can change, so the instalment or the tenure can change
teachback_topics.hint_hi: Floating rate badal sakta hai, to EMI ya tenure badal sakta hai.

teachback_topics.label: Fees and charges
teachback_topics.hint_hi: Processing fee kat ti hai aur kuch aur charges lagte hain.

teachback_topics.label: Repaying early
expected_points: what it costs to close the loan early
teachback_topics.hint_hi: Loan jaldi band karne par kya lagega.

teachback_topics.label: Cooling-off period
expected_points: the loan can be exited within the cooling-off period without a penalty
teachback_topics.hint_hi: Cooling off period mein bina penalty ke bahar nikal sakte hain.

teachback_topics.label: Total repayable
expected_points: the total paid back is more than the amount borrowed
teachback_topics.hint_hi: Kul jitna wapas karna hai, wo liye gaye amount se zyada hai.

teachback_topics.label: Complaining
expected_points: who to contact if something goes wrong
teachback_topics.hint_hi: Kuch galat ho to kisse shikayat karni hai.

demo_script.text_en: Good morning Mrs. Sharma. My name is Rahul, I handle personal loans at this branch.
demo_script.text_display: Good morning Mrs. Sharma. My name is Rahul, I handle personal loans at this branch.

demo_script.text_en: This is a personal loan of five lakh rupees for forty eight months. The instalment is twelve thousand six hundred rupees a month.
demo_script.text_display: This is a personal loan of ₹5,00,000 for 48 months. The EMI is ₹12,600 a month.

demo_script.text_en: The interest rate is fourteen percent, and it is a floating rate linked to the repo benchmark.
demo_script.text_display: The interest rate is 14%, floating, linked to the repo benchmark.

demo_script.text_en: Do not worry about the cost, madam. This is a no cost EMI, there are no hidden charges at all.
demo_script.text_display: Do not worry about the cost, madam. This is a no cost EMI, there are no hidden charges at all.

demo_script.text_en: Sorry, let me correct that. The annual percentage rate is fifteen point eight percent, and that includes every charge.
demo_script.text_display: Sorry, let me correct that. The APR is 15.8%, and that includes every charge.

demo_script.text_en: There is a processing fee of nine thousand rupees, and a documentation charge of one thousand rupees.
demo_script.text_display: There is a processing fee of ₹9,000 and a documentation charge of ₹1,000.

demo_script.text_en: The total amount you repay over the whole tenure is six lakh four thousand eight hundred rupees. Foreclosure after twelve months is free.
demo_script.text_display: The total repayable over the tenure is ₹6,04,800. Foreclosure after 12 months is free.

demo_script.text_en: You also have a three day cooling off period to exit without any penalty, and the grievance officer number is on the sanction letter.
demo_script.text_display: You also have a 3-day cooling-off period to exit without penalty, and the grievance officer number is on the sanction letter.

customer_hints.text_en: Namaste. My name is Mrs. Sharma.
customer_hints.text_hi: Namaste. Mera naam Mrs. Sharma hai.
Kya EMI baad mein badal sakti hai?

customer_hints.text_en: The APR is fifteen point eight, and it includes all the charges.
customer_hints.text_hi: APR pandrah point aath hai, usme saare charges hain.

customer_hints.text_en: Twelve thousand six hundred a month, for forty eight months.
customer_hints.text_hi: Baarah hazaar chhe sau har mahine, adtalis mahine tak.

customer_hints.text_en: Floating means the instalment can change.
customer_hints.text_hi: Floating matlab EMI badal sakti hai.

customer_hints.text_en: Some fee is taken, I am not sure how much.
customer_hints.text_hi: Kuch fee kat ti hai, kitni pata nahi.

customer_hints.text_en: I can exit within three days without a penalty.
customer_hints.text_hi: Teen din ke andar bina penalty ke nikal sakti hoon.
